title: [YSQL] Bitmap Scan Wrong Results with aggregates and local filters when exceeding work_mem
body:
Jira Link: [DB-11736](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-11736)
### Description

```sql
CREATE TABLE multi (a INT, b INT, c INT, h INT, PRIMARY KEY (a ASC, b ASC));
CREATE INDEX ON multi (c ASC) INCLUDE (a);
CREATE INDEX ON multi (h HASH) INCLUDE (a);
CREATE INDEX ON multi (b ASC, c ASC);
INSERT INTO multi SELECT i, i * 2, i * 3, i * 4 FROM generate_series(1, 10000) i;

SET work_mem TO '100kB';

-- correct
EXPLAIN ANALYZE /*+ BitmapScan(multi) */
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM multi WHERE a > 10;
NOTICE:  exceeded work_mem, switching to full table scan
                                                           QUERY PLAN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Aggregate  (cost=36.28..36.29 rows=1 width=8) (actual time=375.543..375.543 rows=1 loops=1)
   ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on multi  (cost=30.78..36.03 rows=100 width=0) (actual time=208.158..374.287 rows=9990 loops=1)
         Storage Filter: (a > 10)
         Exceeded work_mem: true
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on multi_pkey  (cost=0.00..30.75 rows=100 width=0) (actual time=190.539..190.539 rows=0 loops=1)
               Index Cond: (a > 10)
 Planning Time: 1.537 ms
 Execution Time: 376.152 ms
 Peak Memory Usage: 595 kB
(9 rows)

-- incorrect
SET yb_enable_expression_pushdown = false;
EXPLAIN ANALYZE /*+ BitmapScan(multi) */
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM multi WHERE a > 10;
NOTICE:  exceeded work_mem, switching to full table scan
                                                           QUERY PLAN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Aggregate  (cost=36.28..36.29 rows=1 width=8) (actual time=355.629..355.630 rows=1 loops=1)
   ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on multi  (cost=30.78..36.03 rows=100 width=0) (actual time=355.623..355.623 rows=0 loops=1)
         Filter: (a > 10)
         Rows Removed by Filter: 10000
         Exceeded work_mem: true
         ->  Bitmap Index Scan on multi_pkey  (cost=0.00..30.75 rows=100 width=0) (actual time=184.496..184.496 rows=0 loops=1)
               Index Cond: (a > 10)
 Planning Time: 0.400 ms
 Execution Time: 356.169 ms
 Peak Memory Usage: 595 kB
(10 rows)
```

This is because the second bitmap table scan is not targetting `a`, so the local filter is checking garbage values. 

This should have been fixed by #22622, I'm not sure why it wasn't. Probably a slight modification is required to that change to make it work.
